verdict.rationale: No first-party doc describes channel threading or named topics. Graph docs only mention that apps can create channels and conversations, and a community report implies channels have threading because it contrasts them with DMs that lack it. Other users complain that following threads is hard, which bears on how well this helps catch-up, though it is not a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of channel threaded conversations, named topics/subjects per conversation, catch-up aids for busy channels, and positive hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can catch up on busy channels efficiently because every conversation is organized under a named topic or thread

citations.quote: These apps can also automate creating teams, channels, and conversations
inconsistent UI between channels and direct chats (no threading/code blocks in DMs)
